items.body: Basements took water from sewer backups and from sump pumps that stopped.
A sump pump without power can't protect anything.
We figure out which kind you have.

bodies: Some water is a plumbing problem and some comes through the foundation. We handle the plumbing side: [sump pumps](/hanover-park/sump-pumps), battery backups, backflow valves, standpipes and [overhead sewer systems](/hanover-park/overhead-sewer-systems).
If water is seeping through cracks in the walls, a waterproofing contractor is the right call, and we'll tell you so.

blocks.h2: The First Hour of a Basement Flood
blocks.body: Safety comes first. If water is near outlets or the furnace, stay out and shut off power at the panel only if you can reach it from a dry spot. Stop running water upstairs. If the sump pump has stopped, check whether it has power. Move what you can to higher ground and take photos for insurance. Then call us. We'll find out whether the water is coming from the sewer, the ground or a pipe, because each one has a different fix.

blocks.h2: Basement Flooding Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How do I know if it's sewer water or groundwater?
items.answer: Through the floor drain is usually sewer water. Around the sump pit or walls is usually groundwater.

items.q: What's the best protection for my basement?
items.preview: A sump pump with a battery backup, plus backflow protection.
items.answer: For most Hanover Park basements, a reliable sump pump with a battery backup. If you've had sewer backups, add a backflow valve or overhead sewer.

items.preview: We fix the cause. A restoration company dries it.
items.answer: We fix the plumbing cause. A restoration company handles water removal and drying.

items.preview: Sewer backups often need a rider.
items.answer: Sewer and sump backup usually need a separate rider. Check with your agent.

items.q: Should I run a shop vac?
items.preview: For clean water, yes. For sewage, no.
items.answer: For clear groundwater, a shop vac helps. For sewage, leave it to a restoration company.

items.q: How much does basement flooding repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the cause and what's needed. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
